tools.name: resolve_vehicle
tools.description: Use this when identifying a vehicle from a full VIN or from year, make, and model with optional configuration refinements. Returns MATCHED_SINGLE, NEEDS_IDENTITY, or NO_MATCH and never silently chooses among legitimate configurations.

tools.name: get_vehicle_specs
tools.description: Use this when engine and powertrain specifications are needed for a vehicle identified by VIN or year, make, and model. Returns normalized supported facts such as engine, displacement, cylinders, horsepower, transmission, drivetrain, and fuel type only after identity resolves safely.

tools.name: get_vehicle_fitment
tools.description: Use this for wheel and tire fitment after identifying a vehicle by VIN or year, make, and model. Returns available OEM tire sizes, bolt pattern / PCD, center bore, wheel offset, and thread / lug size without guessing through ambiguous configurations.

tools.name: get_vehicle_safety
tools.description: Use this for available NHTSA-backed recalls, complaints, investigations, manufacturer communications, and safety ratings. Safety facts remain explicitly YMM-scoped and never establish configuration identity.

tools.name: get_vehicle_efficiency
tools.description: Use this for available EPA city, highway, and combined MPG, MPGe, range, fuel-cost, emissions, and related efficiency facts after vehicle identity resolves safely. Ambiguous EPA variants remain NEEDS_IDENTITY.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "resolve_vehicle" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "resolve_vehicle" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Resolve a VIN or year/make/model safely. MATCHED_SINGLE is answerable; NEEDS_IDENTITY requires the user to choose; NO_MATCH/UNAVAILABLE must not be guessed." → after: "Use this when identifying a vehicle from a full VIN or from year, make, and model with optional configuration refinements. Returns MATCHED_SINGLE, NEEDS_IDENTITY, or NO_MATCH and never silently chooses among legitimate configurations."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
